\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 247-250 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R254-first-pass-words-from-chapters-247-250}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a tent and a flag.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a twin, a father-in-law, a mother-in-law, a son-in-law, a daughter-in-law
  \item an opportunity, danger, a kindness, a duty, work
  \item wood, marble, glass, hide, linen
  \item a vine, an oak, a pine, a laurel, a violet
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A twin? (\textbf{geminus, geminī}.) A father-in-law? (\textbf{socer, socerī}.) A mother-in-law? (\textbf{socrus, socrūs}.) A son-in-law? (\textbf{gener, generī}.) A daughter-in-law? (\textbf{nurus, nurūs}.) An opportunity? (\textbf{occāsiō, occāsiōnis}.) Danger? (\textbf{perīculum, perīculī}.) A kindness? (\textbf{beneficium, beneficiī}.) A duty? (\textbf{officium, officiī}.) Work? (\textbf{labor, labōris}.) Wood? (\textbf{lignum, lignī}.) Marble? (\textbf{marmor, marmoris}.) Glass? (\textbf{vitrum, vitrī}.) Hide? (\textbf{corium, coriī}.) Linen? (\textbf{līnum, līnī}.) A vine? (\textbf{vītis, vītis}.) An oak? (\textbf{quercus, quercūs}.) A pine? (\textbf{pīnus, pīnūs}.) A laurel? (\textbf{laurus, laurī}.) A violet? (\textbf{viola, violae}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

(\textbf{ampulla, ampullae}.) A frying pan? (\textbf{sartāgō, sartāginis}.) An oven? (\textbf{furnus, furnī}.) A candlestick? (\textbf{candēlābrum, candēlābrī}.) A small tablet? (\textbf{tabella, tabellae}.) Holidays? (\textbf{fēriae, fēriārum}.) A banquet? (\textbf{convīvium, convīviī}.) A sacrifice? (\textbf{sacrificium, sacrificiī}.) An altar? (\textbf{āra, ārae}.) A goddess? (\textbf{dea, deae}.) A pack? (\textbf{sarcina, sarcinae}.) A satchel? (\textbf{pēra, pērae}.) A money bag? (\textbf{marsuppium, marsuppiī}.) A tent? (\textbf{tabernāculum, tabernāculī}.)
